notes.share: projection share along the pure-A -> pure-B activation line at the handoff position: share_full(alpha) = <h_a - h_B, h_A - h_B>/||h_A - h_B||^2 for the full residual; share_lens(alpha) = (<h_a - h_B, u>)/(<h_A - h_B, u>) with u = v_A - v_B the two categories' J-lens vector difference — both are the fraction of the way from the pure-B to the pure-A state, one measured in the full space and one along the categories' J-lens direction
notes.sharpness: the paper's sharpness statistic = the alpha width of the 10%-90% transition of the share curve (linear interpolation on the measured alpha grid; smaller = sharper all-or-none commitment, ~0.8 = smooth linear tracking); None when the curve never crosses both levels; the threshold alpha is the lower crossing
notes.handoff: the handoff position is the LAST PROMPT token (the prefill forward's decoding position, whose distribution predicts generated token 0; the x14 step_records[0] convention) — here the row residual[-1] of the recorded prefill
notes.mixing: f_mix = (1 - alpha) f_A + alpha f_B replaces the projected visual features at the 576 placeholder positions (hook on the multi-modal projector output, the masked_scatter input); pixel values enter only at prefill, so the blend persists through decode via the KV cache
notes.matcher: x13 detect_mentions matcher: one whole-sequence decode, lowercased, category names matched longest-first with word boundaries, optional (s|es) plural suffix, span masking (so 'hot dog' does not also match 'dog'); irregular plurals are a documented gap

interpretation_limits: the committed class uses the REPRESENTATIVE category per image (the annotated category with the best J-lens rank in its own pure run at the readout layer); other annotated objects also influence the caption
the sharpness width is interpolated on the measured alpha grid, so it is bounded below by the grid resolution (default 0.025)
share_lens is undefined when the categories' J-lens vector difference is orthogonal to the A->B activation line (recorded as null widths)
bimodality at the threshold pools each trial's share at ITS OWN threshold alpha (nearest grid point); frac_committed counts shares outside [0.25, 0.75] as committed per-trial
greedy decoding makes the caption commitment deterministic per trial; bimodality here is ACROSS trials (image pairs), not across samples
the tiny backend is a random-weight fixture: it exercises the machinery, its widths and thresholds do not transfer to the real model
